builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Zyra: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (1,174 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 55% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A plant-based zone mage who prepares seeds, roots entry paths and strengthens a garden with a delayed knockup. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Zhonya's Hourglass. Arcane Comet keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Morellonomicon.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Arcane Comet.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 55% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Zyra summons the fury of nature, growing a twisted thicket that deals [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upwards, Knocking Up for [1] second.

Zyra's plants within the thicket become enraged, resetting their duration, gaining [50]% Health and Attacking for [50]% bonus damage.

Zyra plants a Seed that lasts [60] seconds. These Seeds grant True Sight of enemy champions that step on them for [2] seconds, but are still destroyed.

This Ability has 2 charges with a @AmmoRechargeTime@ second recharge time. Killing an enemy minion or monster reduces the recharge time by [35]%. Champion takedowns reduce the recharge time by [100]% instead.

Zyra causes thick vines to spread and explode into spines, dealing [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage.

If this Ability is cast near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Thorn Spitter that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Thorn Spitters have 575 range.

Zyra sends vines forward, Rooting for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] second(s) and dealing [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. 

If this Ability passes near a Seed, the Seed grows into a Vine Lasher that deals @spell.ZyraP:PlantDamage@ magic damage and lasts @spell.ZyraP:PlantDuration@ seconds. Vine Lashers have 400 range, and their Attacks Slow by [30]% for [2] seconds. The Slow from multiple Vine Lashers stacks up to [2] times.

Zyra spawns Seeds around herself every [characterLevelInterpolation(13.6 → 9.05; raw flags preserved)] seconds that last 30 seconds. She can have 8 Seeds planted at once. If an enemy champion steps on a Seed, it dies. Zyra will not spawn Seeds while hiding in brush.

These Seeds are used by her other Abilities to spawn plants that deal [characterLevelInterpolation(15 → 75; raw flags preserved) + (0.2) × AP] magic damage.

builds.name: Enraged plant shred
builds.summary: Test plant-driven MR reduction while R extends their attack opportunity.
builds.goal: Test plant-driven MR reduction while R extends their attack opportunity.
builds.hypothesis: Q/E grow plants from finite seeds; R resets plant duration, adds health and increases plant attack damage by 50%. Bloodletter requires magic damage from abilities or passives, making plant classification a testable question. Liandry/Blackfire test sustained ability burn attribution; Cosmic helps stay safely near the controlled area.
testPlan: Required state: Recorded seed count and plants alive inside R, target remains in plant range.
Record plant-only packets and Bloodletter stacks before/after R, then add one direct spell to separate ownership.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Plants are killed before attacks or enemies leave, preventing shred and burn ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Pet magic damage is not automatically an ability/passive hit for every item proc.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Bloodletter's Curse, Liandry's Torment, Blackfire Torch, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Zyra: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A plant-based zone mage who prepares seeds, roots entry paths and strengthens a garden with a delayed knockup. Fix seeds, plant types and target contact. Plant damage and item proc cadence require actual verification; do not assume all plants survive or every hit creates a new burn stack. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Zyra: Fix seeds, plant types and target contact. Plant damage and item proc cadence require actual verification; do not assume all plants survive or every hit creates a new burn stack.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Thick vines spread through the ground and explode into spines, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. If cast near a seed, Deadly Spines grows a Thorn Spitter plant, which fires at enemies from afar. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Zyra's stated kit question: Fix seeds, plant types and target contact. Plant damage and item proc cadence require actual verification; do not assume all plants survive or every hit creates a new burn stack.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Lasher Fanfare zone
builds.summary: Use E control and slowing plants to support nearby allied attacks.
builds.goal: Use E control and slowing plants to support nearby allied attacks.
builds.hypothesis: E roots and grows 400-range Lashers whose slows can stack twice. Bandlepipes activates on slowing or immobilizing champions and grants nearby allies attack speed; Shurelya supports group entry while R's delayed knockup prolongs the zone. Rylai tests whether plant damage renews slow beyond native Lasher control.
testPlan: Required state: Allies within aura range, E hit or qualifying slow confirmed and finite seeds positioned before R.
Measure allied attack intervals after direct E versus plant-only slow, and compare one/two Lasher slow states.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Allies cannot attack or Thorn Spitters replace needed Lashers; redundancy of slows wastes gold.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Bandlepipes' ally attack-speed aura does not prove it accelerates Zyra's pets.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Bandlepipes, Shurelya's Battlesong, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Abyssal Mask, Cryptbloom, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
